title: RBI mandates 100% collateral for stockbroker credit facilities
theme: RBI mandates 100% collateral for stockbroker credit facilities
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: RBI mandates 100% collateral for stockbroker credit facilities
constituentArticles.text: RBI Commercial Banks Credit Facilities Directions 2026: Broker funding must be 100% fully secured; bank guarantees backed by min 50% collateral (25% cash) with 40% haircut on shares from April 1, 2026.

keyFacts: RBI Commercial Banks Credit Facilities Directions 2026: Broker funding must be 100% fully secured; bank guarantees backed by min 50% collateral (25% cash) with 40% haircut on shares from April 1, 2026.
